_readme: Built-in content that ships with the site. 'events' are real, verified listings and always show. Everything under 'samples' is made-up example content: it only shows when data/data.json has no community entries of that kind, and is labelled 'Example' in the UI. Sample event startDate may be 'today' or 'weekend' (resolved at load time); sample prices use daysAgo.

events.title: Independence Day Week-Long Carnival
events.description: A festive, family-friendly evening carnival featuring dynamic carnival games, an interactive digital gaming arena, massive inflatable attractions, a custom horror house, alongside live music and traditional Boduberu cultural performances.

events.title: Official Independence Day Flag-Raising Ceremony
events.description: The official national flag-raising ceremony commemorating 61 years of independence, attended by state leadership. Includes special holiday recitations and a formal performance of the national anthem by the MNDF military band.
events.hostedBy: Government of Maldives & Maldives National Defence Force (MNDF)

events.title: Independence Day Sports and Cultural Activities
events.description: A public display of national pride featuring high-precision military drills by the MNDF, a National Cadet Corps parade, performances from local school groups, and traditional cultural activities.
events.hostedBy: Ministry of Cities, Local Government and Public Works & Malé City Council

events.title: Malé Independence Day Fireworks
events.description: An evening fireworks display in the capital marking the 61st Independence Day, the night after the main flag-raising and parade.

events.title: Malé Independence Day Parade & Route March
events.location: Majeedhee Magu & Boduthakurufaanu Magu (Social Centre to Henveiru Bridge area)
events.description: A parade and route march through the capital island alongside the MNDF military drill, featuring floats reflecting traditional Maldivian history, local folklore, and maritime national identity.
events.hostedBy: Ministry of Cities, Local Government and Public Works & Malé City Council

events.title: Hulhumalé Independence Day Parade
events.description: Hulhumalé mirrors Malé's July 26 program a day later: military drill, cadet and school-group performances, and a float procession through the core avenues of both phases.

events.title: Hulhumalé Float Display & Exhibition Night
events.description: A close-up public exhibition of the official holiday floats gathered at Central Park, accompanied by live cultural entertainment and community gatherings.
